reviews.t: Dale is amazing with cars and body work! He has fixed my moms car several times and it looks New! Thank you for your friendliness and compassion for excellent work!
My car looked new. Way, way above and beyond expectation. He managed to buff things away that I thought would be permanent. Thank you so much for your hard work, my car looks amazing!
brought my Subaru back to its former glory after pretty bad damage to bumper and quarter panel. paint matched perfectly
great place to get your car fixed but he doesn't do to much body work anymre
He has always done a great job on mine and my dad's cars.
